sources.text:
Initialize: Training view images I = {Ii ∈ R M } N i=1 and their associated camera poses P = {ϕ i ∈ R 3×4 } N i=1 .
1: # Pre-Training 3D-GS[16].
2: # Gi with attributes XYZ, SH-3deg, Opacity, Rotation, Scale.
3: Post-Finetuning of Vector Quantization.
Applying vector quantization (VQ) based on the significance score facilitates a reduction in the required codebook size compared to the full model.
Nonetheless, this method results in a decrease in accuracy as it groups the attributes into several clusters (codes).
We observe that the SSIM decreases from 0.923 (#6) to 0.915 (#7), as illustrated in Table2of the main draft.
This observation motivates us to joint optimize all other attributes and the codes post the VQ.
